caveat: Anonymous aggregate of AIS reports, delayed by a few days. No vessel names, identifiers or flags are kept. AIS is self-reported and incomplete: a vessel with no AIS, or out of satellite reach, is not shown. Presence is not fishing, intent or wrongdoing.
cell_shape: rows 0.2 degrees tall; longitude cells per row = max(1, round(360 * cos(row latitude) / 0.2))
